units: <cite ref="Chullin 97b:4">Ib. 97ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ … כרותח</he> what is preserved in salt, is ritually to be considered as if boiled or roasted; a. fr.—[Pl., v. <cite ref="M01520"><he>מָלַח</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Berakhot 44a:9">Ib. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>כל סעודה שאין בה מ׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="M01521"><he>מלח</he></cite>, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a meal without salted preserves is no meal.
